findings.title: Applying the current range is not triggered when a series is added
findings.description: The range effect only reruns when `mount.ready`, `chart`, or `range` changes. Adding a series updates `seriesCountRef` in `src/chart/chart-facade.ts:49-55`, but changing a ref does not rerun the effect. As a result, a chart that becomes populated after mount does not receive the current range unless the range changes later. The translation test changes the range after adding a series, so it does not cover this case.

findings.title: Later operation failures overwrite the documented first error
findings.description: `setOperationError` replaces `current.error` on every failure. This conflicts with the `UseChartProviderResult` contract in `src/chart/chart-operations.ts:77`, which says `error` is the first error. A second failed operation therefore changes the reported error instead of preserving the first.

findings.title: Playwright configuration describes the e2e build as production
findings.description: The comment says the specs use the production build and the same artifact shipped by `pnpm build`, but the web server now builds with `--mode e2e`. That mode includes the test-only harness route, unlike the production build. Update the comment to describe the e2e-specific artifact.
